items.question: How can I book a room in Ella Town?
items.answer: Use our online booking form or contact our reservation line with your dates and number of guests. We confirm availability, room preferences, and can bundle tourism experiences with your stay.

items.question: Can you help plan local tours and activities?
items.answer: Yes. We offer guided hikes, waterfall trips, tea estate visits, train journeys, and village tours. Packages can be arranged daily to match your pace.

items.question: Is breakfast included?
items.answer: Our room rates include a local Sri Lankan breakfast. We also offer optional meal packages for lunch and dinner with traditional and international options.

items.question: What is the check-in/check-out time?
items.answer: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be requested subject to availability.

items.question: Do you offer transport from Ella train station?
items.answer: We offer pickup and drop-off service from Ella train station and bus terminal, plus airport transfers on request.

destinations.headline: Explore Sri Lanka's finest
destinations.tagline: From Ella's misty peaks to golden coastlines — discover the island's most iconic destinations we can take you to.

places.name: Ella
places.description: Home base — tea estates, waterfalls, and the famous Nine Arch Bridge nestled in misty highlands.

places.name: Nine Arch Bridge
places.description: An iconic colonial-era railway viaduct surrounded by lush jungle and tea plantations.

places.name: Ravana Falls
places.description: One of the widest waterfalls in Sri Lanka, tied to the ancient Ramayana legend.

places.name: Little Adam's Peak
places.description: An easy scenic hike offering 360° views of Ella Gap and surrounding tea country.

places.name: Yala National Park
places.description: Sri Lanka's most famous national park — home to leopards, elephants, and coastal lagoons.

places.name: Mirissa
places.description: Golden sand beach famous for whale watching, surfing, and stunning sunsets.

places.name: Sigiriya
places.description: The ancient rock fortress and palace ruins — a UNESCO World Heritage Site rising 200m above the jungle.

places.name: Kandy
places.description: Sacred city housing the Temple of the Tooth Relic, surrounded by hills and a serene lake.

places.name: Nuwara Eliya
places.description: Known as 'Little England' — cool climate, colonial architecture, and the finest tea estates.
